thread:
mia (CS): heads-up: between 05:20-05:50 UTC some final onboarding activations stalled for a small batch of customers. Dashboard shows 'activation_pending'. Need short customer comms + mitigation plan.

kevin (Eng): root cause: a deploy changed retry backoff behavior in the finalizer; excessive backoff caused timeouts instead of retries. Rollback in progress.

yasmin (Ops): timeline: 05:25 detected spike in pending activations; 05:30 rolled back change; 05:36 retried backlog; 05:48 confirmed 11/14 recovered. 3 remain due to outbound webhook failures.

tom (CS): draft message: "TL;DR: brief onboarding delay this morning affected a handful of activations. Most restored automatically; no data lost. We're offering a one-time onboarding credit and hands-on office hours." Approve?

mia (CS): please add: special exec offer for trials at renewal risk and 14-day window for credit. Also include status link placeholder.

kevin (Eng): confirmed no data loss; payloads were retried from durable queues. We'll add a guardrail to prevent the config reaching prod again.

yasmin (Ops): internal affected list (private): atlas-co, beacon-ux, coral-data, dune-markets, ember-tools, flux-health, gale-systems, hemp-commerce, iris-ai, juno-labs, koi-media, luna-retail, mist-analytics, nova-platform. Note: flux-health, dune-markets, and atlas-co need manual retry.

tom (CS): splitting outreach: 1) immediate DM to top 4 renewal-risk trials; 2) group email to rest; 3) spreadsheet to track replies + renewal signals. I'll send DM copies here after.

status-bot: [automated] Incident 1987654321 created  link: https://internal.incidents/1987654321  status: detected -> mitigated (partial).

mia (CS): ok team — send comms and capture any customer concerns in the shared doc. Reconvene in 60m to review manual recoveries. :white_check_mark:
